Your AI vendor is learning your business. Who owns that?

Enterprise AI spending is set to reach $37.5 billion this year. But the real story is not the money — it is what happens to the intelligence your organization creates every time it interacts with an external model.

Every proprietary workflow, every decision pattern, every piece of feedback trains the system. Palantir just made a public push for what they call 'AI sovereignty' — the ability for enterprises to fine-tune and operate models while keeping all data, memory, and model weights under their own roof.

This is the shift executives need to internalize: the model race matters far less than the architecture race. The companies that own their accumulated AI intelligence will compound advantages. The ones that rent it will find their competitive edge living on someone else's servers.

The question is no longer which model scores highest. It is who controls what the model knows about you.

GYanTech AI builds enterprise AI architectures designed for sovereignty from day one. Link in bio.
